stories.headline: The Philippines wins the first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
stories.summary: The first Eurovision Song Contest Asia was held on 14 November at the One Bangkok Forum in Bangkok, with broadcasters from 11 countries taking part. The Philippines won with "Sobra-Sobra", performed by Carmelle, topping both the jury vote and the online vote. Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia and Laos completed the top five.

stories.headline: Italy fines Meta over the Facebook app on Android
stories.summary: Italy's data protection authority has fined Meta €805 million, or US$887 million. It found that the Facebook Android app had access to users' photos and videos without specific consent or disclosure.

stories.headline: Canada finishes free-trade talks with the Philippines
stories.summary: Canada has concluded negotiations on a free-trade agreement with the Philippines, the Canadian prime minister Mark Carney announced. Signing is expected in 2027. The agreement would eliminate more than 90% of tariff lines.

stories.headline: A new icy world beyond Pluto may be a dwarf planet
stories.summary: Astronomers have found an enormous icy world beyond Pluto that could become the sixth officially recognised dwarf planet in the solar system. The object, named 2026 ED138 for now, was picked out in observations from the Simonyi Survey Telescope at the Vera C. Rubin Observatory. It lies about 46 astronomical units from the Sun, where Pluto orbits at about 40.
